title: Internal fidelity is not external predictive validity
claim: Rule coverage, traceability, reproducibility and textbook-case reconstruction can support internal formalization fidelity but cannot by themselves establish real-world predictive accuracy or causal validity.
maturity_note: This is a frozen methodological boundary in the project constitution and D-004/D-012.
wording_ceiling: Report internal and external evaluation separately; do not infer real-world accuracy or causality from source fidelity.

evidence_refs.label: Manuscript v0.1 snapshot
evidence_refs.note: Working manuscript only; not independent evidence of its own quantitative statements.

limitations: External predictive value requires held-out/appropriately blinded tests against baselines.
Causal claims require separate identification assumptions and evidence.
